name: akismet
title: Akismet Anti-spam
description: Checks new comments with the Akismet service and reports spam and legitimate comments your moderators mark, so Akismet learns from them. Needs an Akismet API key.
author: GoPress

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Your Akismet API key (from akismet.com). It is checked with Akismet when you save. Without a key, comments are not checked.

options.label: Put it in the spam folder for review
